optimus_princeps.name: Optimus Princeps
optimus_princeps.description: Tries to include as much territory as possible in their empire. Does not like civilizations who control little territory.

queen_of_the_nile.name: Queen of the Nile
queen_of_the_nile.description: Likes civilizations with powerful armies. Dislikes civilizations with weak ones.

delian_league.name: Delian League
delian_league.description: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.

wonder_obsessed.name: Wonder Obsessed
wonder_obsessed.description: Likes civilizations not competing for wonders, and builds wonders whenever possible. Dislikes losing a wonder to another civilization.

ally_of_enkidu.name: Ally of Enkidu
ally_of_enkidu.description: Likes civilizations who are willing to form a long-term alliance. Dislikes anyone denouncing or attacking his friends and allies.

tlatoani.name: Tlatoani
tlatoani.description: Likes civilizations who have the same Luxury resources as he does, and will try to collect every Luxury resource available. Dislikes civilizations who have a new Luxury resource he has not yet collected.

city_planner.name: City Planner
city_planner.description: Always tries to keep the maximum number of districts in each city. Respects other civilizations who also develop their cities in this fashion.

backstab_averse.name: Backstab Averse
backstab_averse.description: Likes civilizations who are their declared friend. Hates civilizations who backstab and declare surprise wars.

sun_never_sets.name: The Sun Never Sets
sun_never_sets.description: Likes civilizations whose empire spans the world. Dislikes civilizations content with a handful of cities.

iron_crown.name: Iron Crown
iron_crown.description: Dislikes civilizations who court the city-states he means to bring under the crown himself.

westernizer.name: Westernizer
westernizer.description: Admires civilizations who build out their cities in every direction, and learns from them. Dislikes civilizations who leave their cities undeveloped.

cheomseongdae.name: Cheomseongdae
cheomseongdae.description: Likes civilizations who fill their cities with districts of learning. Dislikes civilizations who neglect them.

solitary_observer.name: Solitary Observer
solitary_observer.description: Keeps her own cities close together, and thinks well of civilizations who do not sprawl. Dislikes civilizations who claim half the world.

trade_caravans.name: Trade Caravans
trade_caravans.description: Likes civilizations who keep their word, because a caravan route is only worth what the promise behind it is. Dislikes civilizations who break their agreements.

sea_lanes.name: Sea Lanes
sea_lanes.description: Likes civilizations who stand by their allies across the water. Dislikes civilizations who abandon a friend.

trial_by_combat.name: Trial by Combat
trial_by_combat.description: Likes civilizations with an army worth measuring himself against. Dislikes civilizations too weak to be worth the trouble.

ingoma_yenkosi.name: Ingoma Yenkosi
ingoma_yenkosi.description: Likes civilizations who muster a real army. Holds civilizations with no army in contempt.

king_of_the_eburones.name: King of the Eburones
king_of_the_eburones.description: Likes civilizations strong enough to be worth fighting. Dislikes civilizations who leave themselves undefended.

enthusiastic_disciple.name: Enthusiastic Disciple
enthusiastic_disciple.description: Likes civilizations who share the luxuries of his own court. Dislikes civilizations hoarding a luxury he has never seen.

garden_of_the_east.name: Garden of the East
garden_of_the_east.description: Likes civilizations who honour their agreements. Dislikes civilizations who arrive uninvited and at war.

patron_of_the_arts.name: Patron of the Arts
patron_of_the_arts.description: Likes civilizations who build wonders for the world to admire. Dislikes civilizations who build none.

black_queen.name: The Black Queen
black_queen.description: Likes civilizations that keep their own counsel. Dislikes the artlessly honest.

counter_reformation.name: Counter-Reformation
counter_reformation.description: Likes civilizations that keep their wealth to themselves. Dislikes open markets.

navigators_school.name: School of Navigators
navigators_school.description: Likes civilizations that keep faith with their partners. Dislikes the faithless.

billboard.name: Billboard
billboard.description: Likes civilizations that trade freely. Dislikes those that hoard.

queens_bibliotheque.name: Queen's Bibliotheque
queens_bibliotheque.description: Likes civilizations that raise great works. Dislikes those that build nothing lasting.

last_viking_king.name: Last Viking King
last_viking_king.description: Likes civilizations that keep a strong army. Dislikes the undefended.

union_of_crowns.name: Union of Crowns
union_of_crowns.description: Likes civilizations that hold their alliances. Dislikes those that break them.

lithuanian_union.name: Lithuanian Union
lithuanian_union.description: Likes civilizations that grow their realm. Dislikes those that stay small.

raven_king.name: Raven King
raven_king.description: Likes civilizations that leave the small states alone. Dislikes their patrons.

diplomatic_marriage.name: Diplomatic Marriage
diplomatic_marriage.description: Likes civilizations that win by arrangement. Dislikes those that win by siege.

father_of_the_country.name: Father of the Country
father_of_the_country.description: Likes civilizations that leave monuments. Dislikes those that leave nothing.

bannockburn.name: Bannockburn
bannockburn.description: Likes civilizations that can defend themselves. Dislikes the weak.

high_king.name: High King
high_king.description: Likes civilizations that stand by their word. Dislikes the treacherous.

red_cross.name: Red Cross
red_cross.description: Likes civilizations that keep their treaties. Dislikes the perfidious.

serenissima.name: La Serenissima
serenissima.description: Likes civilizations that keep the trade lanes open. Dislikes those that close them.

emperor_of_the_serbs.name: Emperor of the Serbs
emperor_of_the_serbs.description: Likes civilizations that expand boldly. Dislikes the timid.

tsar_of_the_bulgars.name: Tsar of the Bulgars
tsar_of_the_bulgars.description: Likes civilizations that keep a standing army. Dislikes the defenceless.

from_sea_to_sea.name: From Sea to Sea
from_sea_to_sea.description: Likes civilizations that reach across the map. Dislikes those hemmed in.

cossack_hetman.name: Cossack Hetman
cossack_hetman.description: Likes civilizations that ride to war prepared. Dislikes the unready.

winter_war.name: Winter War
winter_war.description: Likes civilizations that can hold a border. Dislikes those that cannot.

impaler.name: The Impaler
impaler.description: Likes civilizations feared by their neighbours. Dislikes the harmless.

lord_novgorod_the_great.name: Lord Novgorod the Great
lord_novgorod_the_great.description: Likes civilizations that trade in good faith. Dislikes those that close their markets.

drill_and_discipline.name: Drill and Discipline
drill_and_discipline.description: Likes civilizations that drill their armies. Dislikes the slovenly.

llibre_del_consolat.name: Llibre del Consolat
llibre_del_consolat.description: Likes civilizations that keep a lawful market. Dislikes the closed and grasping.

shore_of_traders.name: Shore of Traders
shore_of_traders.description: Likes civilizations that keep their harbours open. Dislikes those that shut them.

siege_engines.name: Siege Engines
siege_engines.description: Likes civilizations that keep a fearsome army. Dislikes the soft.

king_of_kings.name: King of Kings
king_of_kings.description: Likes civilizations that rule widely. Dislikes those content with little.

mountain_confederacy.name: Mountain Confederacy
mountain_confederacy.description: Likes civilizations that field real armies. Dislikes paper ones.

eight_banners.name: Eight Banners
eight_banners.description: Likes civilizations that keep their armies in order. Dislikes the disorganised.

golden_treasury.name: Golden Treasury
golden_treasury.description: Likes civilizations that keep coin moving. Dislikes misers.

horse_archers.name: Horse Archers
horse_archers.description: Likes civilizations with cavalry to spare. Dislikes the footbound.

caravan_cities.name: Caravan Cities
caravan_cities.description: Likes civilizations that keep the roads open. Dislikes those that close them.

lawgiver.name: The Lawgiver
lawgiver.description: Likes civilizations that keep order by strength. Dislikes the disordered.

ayyubid_dynasty.name: Ayyubid Dynasty
ayyubid_dynasty.description: Likes civilizations that keep faith with allies. Dislikes betrayers.

wisdom_of_solomon.name: Wisdom of Solomon
wisdom_of_solomon.description: Likes civilizations that deal honestly. Dislikes the false.

king_of_kings_armenia.name: Great King
king_of_kings_armenia.description: Likes civilizations that hold wide borders. Dislikes the shrunken.

golden_age_georgia.name: Georgian Golden Age
golden_age_georgia.description: Likes civilizations that protect their friends. Dislikes those that abandon them.

scourge_of_kings.name: Scourge of Kings
scourge_of_kings.description: Likes civilizations that campaign relentlessly. Dislikes the settled.

great_jute.name: The Great Steppe
great_jute.description: Likes civilizations that range widely. Dislikes those that stay put.

hellenic_east.name: The Hellenic East
hellenic_east.description: Likes civilizations that build in stone. Dislikes those that leave no trace.

lion_of_judah.name: Lion of Judah
lion_of_judah.description: Likes civilizations that can defend their independence. Dislikes the conquered.

red_sea_trade.name: Red Sea Trade
red_sea_trade.description: Likes civilizations that keep the sea lanes open. Dislikes those that raid them.

golden_one.name: The Golden One
golden_one.description: Likes civilizations that trade in luxuries. Dislikes those that hoard them.

first_among_kings.name: First Among Kings
first_among_kings.description: Likes civilizations that ride well. Dislikes those that cannot.

sankore.name: Sankore
sankore.description: Likes civilizations that share their wealth. Dislikes the tight-fisted.

salt_and_gold.name: Salt and Gold
salt_and_gold.description: Likes civilizations that keep caravans moving. Dislikes those that tax them dry.

walls_of_benin.name: Walls of Benin
walls_of_benin.description: Likes civilizations that build to last. Dislikes those that build nothing.

asantehene.name: Asantehene
asantehene.description: Likes civilizations that hold their ground. Dislikes those that yield it.

monsoon_trade.name: Monsoon Trade
monsoon_trade.description: Likes civilizations that sail to trade. Dislikes those that sail to raid.

great_enclosure.name: The Great Enclosure
great_enclosure.description: Likes civilizations that raise great works. Dislikes those that do not.

kabaka.name: The Kabaka
kabaka.description: Likes civilizations that keep their promises. Dislikes those that forget them.

alaafin.name: The Alaafin
alaafin.description: Likes civilizations that keep a standing force. Dislikes the unguarded.

veiled_men.name: The Veiled Men
veiled_men.description: Likes civilizations that command the open country. Dislikes those penned in.

merina_unifier.name: Merina Unifier
merina_unifier.description: Likes civilizations that unify their island. Dislikes the fragmented.

pillars_of_ashoka.name: Pillars of Ashoka
pillars_of_ashoka.description: Likes civilizations that keep the peace they promise. Dislikes oathbreakers.

bushido.name: Bushido
bushido.description: Likes civilizations that keep a disciplined army. Dislikes the disorderly.

horde.name: The Horde
horde.description: Likes civilizations that campaign without rest. Dislikes the sedentary.

dharma_king.name: Dharma King
dharma_king.description: Likes civilizations that keep faith. Dislikes those that break it.

unifier_of_the_hills.name: Unifier of the Hills
unifier_of_the_hills.description: Likes civilizations that unite their highlands. Dislikes the divided.

let_no_drop_be_wasted.name: Let No Drop Be Wasted
let_no_drop_be_wasted.description: Likes civilizations that build great works. Dislikes those that build none.

sea_empire.name: Sea Empire
sea_empire.description: Likes civilizations that reach across the water. Dislikes those that stay ashore.

rivers_of_gold.name: Rivers of Grain
rivers_of_gold.description: Likes civilizations that trade their surplus. Dislikes those that withhold it.

ganimi_kava.name: Ganimi Kava
ganimi_kava.description: Likes civilizations that fight cleverly. Dislikes the ponderous.

temple_builder.name: Temple Builder
temple_builder.description: Likes civilizations that raise temples. Dislikes those that raise none.

father_governs_children.name: Father Governs Children
father_governs_children.description: Likes civilizations that shelter their friends. Dislikes those that abandon them.

builder_of_pagodas.name: Builder of Pagodas
builder_of_pagodas.description: Likes civilizations that leave monuments. Dislikes the plain.

palapa_oath.name: The Palapa Oath
palapa_oath.description: Likes civilizations that gather many islands. Dislikes those that hold one.

sea_raiders.name: Sea Raiders
sea_raiders.description: Likes civilizations that keep a fleet. Dislikes those without one.

manifest_destiny.name: Manifest Destiny
manifest_destiny.description: Likes civilizations that push their frontier. Dislikes those that stand still.

honest_broker.name: Honest Broker
honest_broker.description: Likes civilizations that keep their treaties. Dislikes those that tear them up.

longhouse_council.name: Longhouse Council
longhouse_council.description: Likes civilizations that hold their confederacies together. Dislikes those that split.

written_word.name: The Written Word
written_word.description: Likes civilizations that record themselves. Dislikes those that leave nothing.

black_hills.name: The Black Hills
black_hills.description: Likes civilizations that hold their land. Dislikes those that surrender it.

qhapaq_nan.name: Qhapaq Nan
qhapaq_nan.description: Likes civilizations that bind their empire with roads. Dislikes the disconnected.

el_dorado.name: El Dorado
el_dorado.description: Likes civilizations that trade their treasures. Dislikes those that bury them.

never_conquered.name: Never Conquered
never_conquered.description: Likes civilizations that resist conquest. Dislikes those that submit.

liberator.name: The Liberator
liberator.description: Likes civilizations that free their neighbours. Dislikes those that subjugate them.

citadel_of_civilisation.name: Citadel of Civilisation
citadel_of_civilisation.description: Likes civilizations that stand by their allies in war. Dislikes those that stand aside.

kaitiakitanga.name: Kaitiakitanga
kaitiakitanga.description: Likes civilizations that treat the land as a trust. Dislikes those that strip it.
